title: Add a branch
text: A new branch starts with the settings, receipt template, and theme of your first branch, plus default payment methods. Products are not copied. Import them after.
steps: Click Sidebar > Branches. Owners/Super Admin only.
Click Add Branch.
Type the name, branch code or TIN, Branch Location, Type of business, and Operating Hours.
Click Save. If you see Branch Limit Reached, upgrade your plan first.
Then click Products, then Product List, then Import Products. Copy from another branch.

title: Switch branch
text: Everything you see is for one branch at a time. The branch name at the top of every page is the switcher.
steps: Click Sidebar > Branches. Owners/Super Admins only.
Select a branch card.
Or Sidebar > Dashboard, then click the branch name at the top.
Select a branch.
Owners can select All Branch for a combined view.
Select one branch before opening Settings.

title: Edit or delete a branch
text: Each branch card has a menu with Edit and Delete. Both ask for the admin password. A branch that still has products cannot be deleted.
steps: Click Sidebar > Branches. Owners/Super Admins only.
Click the three dots on the branch card.
Click Edit to change the name, location, type, or hours. Click Save.
Click Delete to remove it. Reset the Branch first if the branch has a past Transaction.

title: Per-branch settings and prices
text: Each branch has its own settings, prices, taxes, receipt template, and reports. Products and categories are shared by all branches.
steps: Click Sidebar > Dashboard and click the branch name at the top. Select the branch you want to update.
Change that branch's settings or prices.
To copy a receipt template, go to Settings > Receipts & Reports > Apply to all branches.
To copy products and prices, go to Products > Product List > Import Products, then choose the branch to copy from.
Note: BIR-registered stores cannot copy receipt templates. Set up each branch's template separately.
keywords: iba-iba ba ang presyo bawat branch

title: Branch sales cards and sorting
text: Each card shows gross and net sales for the chosen period and a plan badge: Freemium, Pro, Pro Trial, or Expired. The period starts on the last 7 days.
steps: Click Sidebar > Branches. Owners/Super Admins only.
Click the date button at the top to change the period.
Search by name, address, or branch code.
Select Custom Order and drag the cards to rearrange them, or select Alphabetical to sort them by name.
keywords: paano tingnan ang benta ng bawat branch

title: Trial on a new branch
text: The Pro trial is one window for the whole store. A new branch joins the same window. It does not get a fresh trial of its own.
steps: Click Sidebar > Settings > Account & Subscription.
Check the Pro trial status and remaining days.
Click Start trial on a branch.
Add branches during the active trial to give them the remaining days.
When the trial ends, open Manage Plans.
Upgrade each branch you want to keep on Pro.

title: Add products to a new branch
text: Products are not copied when you create a branch. Import them from an existing branch before selling or receiving stock there.
steps: Click Sidebar > Products > Product List.
Click Import Products.
Select the branch to copy from.
Choose the products and prices to import.
Click Import.
keywords: Paano Magdagdag ng produkto sa bagong branch

title: View all branch sales
text: Owners can use All Branch to see combined information across branches. Use one branch when a page needs branch-specific settings.
steps: Click Sidebar > Dashboard, then click the branch name at the top.
Select All Branch.
View the combined sales.
Select one branch for Settings.
keywords: paano mag-view ng lahat ng branch

title: Change branch information
text: Owners can update a branch name, address, business type, and hours from the branch card menu. Changes apply to that branch only.
steps: Click Sidebar > Branches. Owners/Super Admin only.
Click the three dots on the branch card.
Click Edit.
Or Select a branch then click Settings > Business Details.
Update the branch details.
Click Save.

title: New branch setup
text: A new branch copies your settings, receipt template, theme, and default payment methods. Products and prices must be added separately.
steps: Create the new branch.
Review its copied settings, receipt template, theme, and payment methods.
Go to Products > Product List > Import Products.
Choose another branch and import the products.
Check the product prices before selling.
keywords: ano ang kasama sa bagong branch

title: Check existing branch
text: Open the Branches page to review your current branches, their status, sales, and plan. This is the quickest way to see what already exists before creating or editing anything.
steps: Click Sidebar > Branches.
Look at each branch card to see the name, plan, and sales summary.
Use the search box or date selector to narrow the list.
Click a branch card to open it or use the menu for edit and delete options.
